skill.displayName: Big8 · 算八字·玄学算命助手（八字排盘·算命·风水·面相·星座·每日一卦）| Chinese Fortune Telling, Feng Shui & BaZi

version.changelog: 优化 description：补八字排盘/星座运势/老黄历关键词

llm.summary: The skill is mostly coherent for a fortune-telling assistant, but it asks agents to analyze selfies and private room photos with unclear consent and overconfident privacy claims.

dimensions.detail: The privacy language says images are not uploaded to third parties while the artifacts also depend on a Vision Model for image analysis; the actual data flow and model trust boundary are not clearly explained.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, network setup, credential collection, or hidden install-time behavior was found. The Python script is a local CLI helper for bazi, zodiac, gua, and huangli calculations.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime rules say any image enters image mode, and pure images are automatically classified into feng shui or face-reading flows. This can process sensitive images without an explicit user text request for that analysis.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The script writes a hidden .big8_gua_state.json file beside the script to keep the same daily divination result. This is low-sensitivity persistence but is not disclosed in the user-facing skill text.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Face reading and feng shui image analysis are core stated features, but the skill explicitly analyzes selfies, facial structure, moles, and home interiors, which are sensitive personal or private images.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending selfies, face images, and room photos to the agent's vision system for entertainment-style analysis. Avoid uploading third-party faces without permission, and treat the privacy claim as incomplete unless the publisher clarifies exactly where image inference happens and what retention rules apply.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the artifacts combine a no-third-party-upload privacy claim with Vision Model analysis, but do not define whether the model provider is inside the same trust boundary.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: image analysis is purpose-aligned, but auto-entering image mode for any image and routing pure images to face or room analysis lacks clear opt-in for sensitive photos.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: broad divination phrases may cause nuisance activation, but they do not create a high-impact security concern by themselves.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted: the skill encourages selfie-based face reading and personality or fortune interpretation without a prominent warning that face images are sensitive personal data.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted as low impact only: the hidden daily-gua state file stores a date and selected divination result, not credentials or user content, but should be disclosed.
